name: code-resonance
description: Capture software development as a private local audiovisual performance with Code Resonance.

resonance.receiverPort.description: Loopback receiver port in the same VS Code extension host (including WSL/SSH).

resonance.baselineFileLimit.description: Maximum workspace files indexed when recording begins.

resonance.includeHidden.description: Permit dotfile filenames in initial indexing. Files matching secret exclusions are always omitted.

resonance.captureDocumentContents.description: Send bounded source snapshots to the private loopback receiver for AST analysis; never exposed by Stage API. Requires explicit Start command.

resonance.captureTerminalCommands.description: Record raw terminal command lines. Disabled by default to avoid capturing credentials. Start/end/exit events still recorded.

resonance.capturePromptText.description: Allow explicit Record AI Prompt command to include prompt text. Normally records only length and fingerprint.
